integrated_graph.name: quant_dflash_recompute
integrated_graph.binding: manifest names are authoritative aliases for OM bindings at the same index
integrated_graph.anchor: last valid input token; excluded from target feature context and placed at DFlash block row zero

generation_backend.preferred_runner_abi: pretokenized prompt/EOS IDs in; paired ordinary/DFlash JSON out; one loaded model, persistent buffers and one ACL stream

modes.ordinary-greedy: commit target_top1 at the last valid row
modes.dflash-strict-greedy: accept the longest proposal prefix equal to target predictions, then commit target correction/bonus

step.token_ids: one or more committed non-negative token IDs
step.finished: true only at EOS or a declared terminal target state

metadata_required.artifacts: exact mapping of loaded graph names to OM SHA-256

ordinary_parity.required_counts: 3 warmups plus 10 measured repetitions for both reports

cpp_runtime.model_load: once per paired benchmark process and excluded from model-loop latency
cpp_runtime.memory: aclrtMallocHost plus persistent aclrtMalloc buffers/datasets; after the first full upload, each input copies only its changed contiguous range
cpp_runtime.execution: one stream queues ranged H2D, aclmdlExecuteAsync, the last K+1 Target rows plus full Draft IDs D2H, followed by one aclrtSynchronizeStream per OM call
cpp_runtime.execution_io_report: actual versus full-equivalent transfer bytes, operations, skipped H2D copies, model executions and stream synchronizations
cpp_runtime.memory_query: runner report records aclmdlQuerySize work_bytes and weight_bytes before load
cpp_runtime.measurement_order: ordinary and DFlash warmups/measurements alternate in one process
cpp_runtime.integrity: C++ recomputes the expected OM SHA-256 before aclmdlLoadFromFile

strict_rules: ATC core arguments cannot be overridden
AIR payload hashes are checked immediately before ATC
OM hashes are checked immediately before backend construction
CPU fallback is rejected for target reports
measured repetitions must return identical token IDs and stop reason
DFlash target report requires a passing ordinary-greedy report
